"REQ: LANG-731 LANG-732 LANG-733 LANG-734"
Object subclass: #Greeter
    instanceVariableNames: 'name count'
    classVariableNames: ''
    package: 'Demo'.

"Greets the name.
 Multi-line comment."
Greeter >> greet: times [
    | text |
    text := 'Hello, ', name, '! it''s fine'.
    times > 0 ifTrue: [ ^ text , String cr ] ifFalse: [ ^ nil ].
    count := count + 1.
    ^ self
]

| g |
g := Greeter new.
Transcript show: (g greet: 2); cr.
#(1 2 3) do: [:each | Transcript show: each printString].
$a isVowel & true | false.
16r1F + 3.14e0 + 2/3.
thisContext printString.
